description: All ShaderBankFile v3 slots, with reproducible bank/cache/runtime hash joins.

hash_semantics.bank_identity: XXH3-64 over exact extracted raw microcode bytes (guest byte order)
hash_semantics.cache_identity: XXH3-64 stored in XESH .xsh, revalidated over cache bytecode
hash_semantics.exact_match: runtime XXH3 equals a bank slot's raw microcode XXH3
hash_semantics.vertex_fetch_candidate: same-size XSH VS differs only in dwords belonging to bank instructions whose low-five-bit opcode is vertex-fetch (0); heuristic candidate, not proven ancestry
